features.quote: Hard cap: 40 tool calls or 15 minutes wall time.
Economic kill switch: If token spend exceeds 2× the 95th percentile of historical stable runs for that variant, force-terminate and label Grade 3
features.justification_quote: An unbounded SCL on a 128k context is expensive within minutes.
